name: Clinical Trial Management
one_liner: Study and site management with milestones, visits, monitoring reports and issues.
fits_when: a sponsor or CRO runs one or more studies across many investigator sites
start-up milestones and site activation need to be tracked against plan
CRAs plan and log monitoring visits and submit visit reports for review
issues and protocol deviations must go to the site for a response and be signed off
sites need their own login that shows only their own visits and action items
enrollment comes from an EDC and reports and records must be filed to the eTMF
gives_you: Studies with phase, indication, enrollment target and a planning-to-closed lifecycle
Milestone plans per study with forecast dates and automatic At Risk and Missed flags
Site activation gated on documents and the SIV, with an auto-created site login
Monitoring visits from scheduling through visit report submission, return and approval
Issue and deviation tracking with site responses, CRA verification and severity-based sign-off
Study and site 360 pages with enrollment, open issues, visits and an activity timeline

catalogue.description: A clinical trial management system for sponsors and CROs: set up studies and their start-up milestones, select and activate investigator sites once their documents and initiation visit are in place, track enrollment against target, and let CRAs schedule and log monitoring visits and submit visit reports for study manager approval. Issues and protocol deviations raised at visits go to the site for a response, are verified by the CRA and signed off by severity. Sites sign in to see only their own visits and action items.

roles.name: Study Manager
roles.description: Sets up studies and milestones, activates sites, approves visit reports and signs off major and critical issues

roles.name: CRA
roles.description: Monitors assigned sites: schedules and logs visits, writes visit reports, raises and verifies issues

roles.name: Site
roles.description: External login for the site coordinator: sees only its own site, confirms visits and responds to action items

workflows.name: Study setup
workflows.description: Protocol, phase, enrollment target and a milestone plan from protocol final to database lock

workflows.name: Site management
workflows.description: Site selection, activation gated on documents and the SIV, enrollment tracking, hold and close

workflows.name: Monitoring visits
workflows.description: Visits scheduled, logged, reported within five working days, reviewed and approved with a follow-up letter

workflows.name: Issue tracking

compliance: ICH E6 GCP-style audit trail of every change, transition and upload
Maker-checker: a visit report is approved by someone other than its author
Severity-based sign-off before major and critical deviations are closed
Row-level access: each site sees only its own records; CRAs see their assigned sites
Approved visit reports and closed issues filed to the eTMF
catalogue.app_prompt_prefill: Clinical trial management for our oncology portfolio: three Phase II/III studies running at 38 sites across India. CRAs schedule monitoring visits every six weeks, log them and submit visit reports within five working days for study manager approval. Issues and protocol deviations raised at visits go to the site for a response; the CRA verifies them, major ones need study manager sign-off and critical ones also the medical monitor's. Study managers track start-up milestones, site activation and enrollment against target, with enrollment pulled nightly from the EDC and approved reports filed to the eTMF.
